items.title: D'Imperio interviewed by Monk Rowe, 2014
items.q: But the thing is that he was smart and half of the tunes that he made popular were public domain.

ctx.x: Well I wouldn’t say that because he had that clarinet lead. But the thing is that he was smart and half of the tunes that he made popular were public domain. “Little Brown Jug,” “American Patrol,” I can’t remember all of them but he didn’t have to pay any royalties on those tunes you know, so I mean he made a fortune. I mean well of course there’s some different opinions on that. Some people say that Glenn Miller should have lived and his music should have died. Other people say that he should have — the plane…
Do you get payments, royalties, for any of the stuff you’ve done?
